notes.title: THE RELEASE IS NOW OLD MAN!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we're very excited to present to you Bodacious Agent's full release! One of us has moved house since our last update in August, but we've worked hard in that time and we're confident in showing you the results of our efforts. Without further adieu - in this release update:
[list]
[*] A full superspy experience across 6 levels (including a boat race and a trip to the moon!)
[*] A complete cast of villains (with full pulp!)
[*] A variety of gadgets to assist you
[*] Disguises! (So many disguises! See if you can find them all!)
[*] Two additional agents (and Lerry) for you to unlock (other than Agent Gertz), with a unique set of disguises for every character
[*] Full soundtrack
[*] One or two secret things for the keen eyed
[/list]

Thank you to those who have supported us and followed us on this journey. To those who tried our demo, thank you as well, and we encourage you to (please) try it again! We've streamlined and improved various systems and features we introduced in previous updates and learned much as a result. 

If you liked this project and want to be updated on our future works, there is a patreon you can follow [url=https://www.patreon.com/PirateDaveProductions]here[/url].

We hope you enjoy, thanks all!
Aristophanes Yates and Pirate Dave

notes.title: Quick Xmass Update
notes.notes:
Just a few stocking stuffers while we were reorganizing our workflow and preparing for that Early Access release. Christmas came a little late at B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S. HQ, but we hope those few of you who played this December enjoyed the second coming of Halloween! Future Decembers should be a tad more jingle jangle, and for what remains of this one.

In this update:
- Christmas outfits and decorations at HQ (the Training level)
- Fixed Halloween decorations subsuming all holidays (back to October, where you belong!)
- A lot of groundwork and bug fixes mostly pertaining to future content (gadgets, outfits, new levels)
- Reworked some of the girls' textures
- Streamer mode (Censor mosaic)

Happy New Year's Eve! 

P.S.
We apologise to our players closer to the Eastern Hemisphere for the delay, and wish them a happy New Year!

notes.title: big update to the demo!
notes.notes:
Our newest super secret agent, Sarah! An operative capable of great leaps and bounds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/c58a088e3fe3594409988ac47416b27e1b6ff047.png[/img]

Equipped with her background as a world-class athlete, she is a truly towering figure at B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/b17e7df46056720290cd257bbb5877ee055dbe39.png[/img]

A tutorial plus two full feature levels (includes new level, The Mall!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/b4121a5322605b1105b0d7df1b0119848f01a49e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/46aca33026db8a2ac8a51bf2d2f44534e74c7f49.png[/img]

Improved combat - Enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/c0b9f91fed29fd27766c956ac24665e8aaa3643c.png[/img]

Three all new saucy outfits for you to find! Here’s a sneak peak!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/d0ab5a51cf2988c4634de84ca7704f0c4030c188.png[/img]

Story? You got it! We made a whole system for cut scenes. It's got sprites, words and buttons!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/61765dedef04cd19ee82de262263f9032797fae4.png[/img]

And the little things here and there that once vexed us. Like this little ledge-grab animation that now works for all available characters and outfits!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/1787c3f22adbb81562f16f52114c546ff19531b1.png[/img]

That’s all for now, we’ll have another smaller update this October. We hope you enjoy Sarah and the new level. Please don’t hesitate to contact us to tell us what you think (or just to say hi)! You can contact us via: 
our subreddit (https://www.reddit.com/r/BodaciousAgents/comments/16yghhq/stick_your_feedback_here/), 
our email (bodaciousfans@gmx.com), 
or by replying to this very community post! 
Signed, Pirate Dave and Aristophanes Yates
